title: Build deterministic Fleet resource simulator
description: Implement the simulator around the production scheduling core. Exercise topology-aware placement, nested leases, stale agents, node/cell partitions, provider failures, and 1k–1M-node hierarchical simulations.

logs.msg: First proof is the accepted kernel and fencing v0 cases on a tiny workspace, not the 1k-1M hierarchical run in the original description.
Starting tiny workspace: fleet-kernel transition function plus fleet-sim deterministic delivery. First proof is v0 kernel and fencing cases.
v0 workspace landed: fleet-kernel transition function plus fleet-sim delivery/faults. cargo test --workspace 19 passed; clippy -D warnings clean. Fence-before-prepare tombstones the generation.
